prs.title: eval: Requests V19 candidate shard and protocol migration (custody blocked)
prs.head: 67f89aff2392ced113327cfe8f671cd153c7e0c8
prs.body:
Prepares the exclusive Requests author shard from fixed PR60 bc8e22bd6b4f85774e7b84a3e6a30da8dc4a3b29. Every changed path remains under crates/cc-eval/benchmarks/public-v19/requests/. Pinned public source psf/requests@611c6162cbc4ac2020a2f91c7cfa4f3abf9bbb60 and Apache-2.0 primary LICENSE SHA25609e8a9bcec8067104652c168685ab0931e7868f9c8284b66f5ae6edae5f1130b match retained source bytes.19 Python files plus pyproject snapshot; LICENSE/NOTICE retained, complete128-file exclusion inventory. Three adapted Werkzeug header helpers retain their upstream permission notices and are excluded from gold spans, but the evaluator cannot exclude individual function bytes from indexing; independent license admission remains pending.

Authored100 candidate IDs in original draft order, category target20exact/API,20behavior,15facets,20crossfile,10config/error,15hardnegative. Conservative related-task association yields86 proposed global components, not100 certified independent samples;14 components remain short of100, subject to designated global review. Independently accepted0. Migrated once before ranking to opaque v19.requests.f0001..f0100 and protocol PR65 fixed03abe24950f1fa89de3cce0a4e1d44d01e9aa0d6. SHA256 threshold split gives75dev/25expected-holdout rows,66dev/20expected-holdout components; not rebalanced and not globally frozen. Public current projection contains75native dev and67compat dev, excluding8native no-answer rows from compat. facets/edges and source SHA/path/symbol/line-byte span hashes are retained. Candidate family_set_sha25664897a5a9ac5e761fa036064135352537053153f85d52702555d330678dbf8cd; component_split_sha256c0dc9b73f48075003b10ed14edac090a992adbd877713313c6f7c8146dc79d5a.

Holdout custody is BLOCKED. First20 preprotocol question bodies were already public;25 expected-holdout drafts were accessible in the shared workspace, including2 in prior public Git history. Existing history and old hash/ID/split mappings are preserved. No new holdout bodies are included in current public projections. Hash/count commitments are computed from migrated drafts in memory; they do not prove separate restricted storage. Separately held/reviewed/usable formal holdout0.25 contaminated candidate rows cannot certify confirmatory holdout; deleting files does not restore secrecy. Independent custodian/global reviewer must adjudicate access provenance. This is not a protocol-reviewed complete20/100 block.

Actual validation: locked Rust1.95 cc-eval build receipt; native and compat dev validate exit0; primary license/source inventory bytes verified against pinned public archive rerun; public dev AST span/edge/scoped-absence integrity checks pass. Protocol checker0errors, receipt SHA2567bcda16f7451234a511a3f1ba78c25d497697023e68b2a5eacfa6c805f7f51d6. Automated integrity is not semantic gold or independent review. No retrieval ranking, tuning, live provider, private-source egress, historical306raw claim, production/scorer/Cargo/shared registry/tasks/TODO changes, merge/forcepush/deployment. Remaining: independent source/gold/absence review, adapted-helper license admission, global equivalence adjudication,14 independent components and real uncontaminated holdout custody.

prs.body:

Earlier a739431100IDs/98components68native/57compat remains the historical snapshot. No body reads/setup/new reviewers for this correction.

Four-repo total117would-beholdout IDs, reported-exposure lower bound72, clean held-out0. Requests23 and TypeScript22 remaining unknown are not presumed private; serde/vite candidate gaps remain explicit. Earlier disclosure/history preserved; deleting/relabel/no-ranking never restores privacy.

Preregisters actual unchanged evaluator v1 schema, native/compat separation, opaque global IDs/components, deterministic expected75/25 split, source/license metadata, native/compat/facet/span/no-answer denominators, macro/micro and planned repository-membership-stratified paired family-cluster bootstrap before ranking. Authority09 nDCG0.01 /Top1 1pp are review triggers, not acceptance tolerances; conservative future semantic design requires gain CI lower>0 and exact CI lower>=0. Facet/graph/Recall20/global-statistical implementation gaps remain declared; no scorer change.

Executable custody workflow requires independently verified existing authorized boundary and reader/audience provenance; hashes/claims do not authenticate ACLs. Library harmless permission/list reads succeeded but agent/owner exclusion or reader audit not verified; no upload/share/revoke. Independent-task disk also unverified. Three earlier metadata-only commit-header attempts stopped at transport blockers without alternate route; first visibility/actual readers unknown. Parent-owned Express/Requests dev-only reviews continue20 then all dev. No real query/gold/holdout body read by custody owner, ranking/live calls0, permission/credential/history changes0.

Verification: original13 protocol regressions13/0; custody8/0 including unknown-count preservation. Earlier two invented native/compat suites validated by actual exact-build evaluator/hash and35 unchanged source/lock proofs; receipt repeated byte-identically. Latest custody expected exit1 blocked,117/72/0 and exact corrected Express metadata asserted;27artifact hashes verified. Checker never certifies clean holdout. No source-gold review/holdout evaluation/global bootstrap/workspace tests claimed. Full V19 remains open.

prs.title: V19 Express candidate intake: 100 drafts, PR65 migration and custody blocker
prs.head: a739431b6595bb44e79130843e27e2cde2d34eb1
prs.body:
Express 独立作者分片，仅改 crates/cc-eval/benchmarks/public-v19/express/；基线固定 PR60 bc8e22bd6b4f85774e7b84a3e6a30da8dc4a3b29，未 merge/force push/deploy。

源 SHA 7ef98448f8b38099ab1ded55e458538ad47a51e7；MIT license SHA256 95a5762890e5c1c9808921cef095661fc482c5e1f0bba31446ac85595df6237c。7 个手写公共核心 JS 的原字节/SHA256/Git blob、排除清单、精确 line-byte spans 已核验；未纳入依赖实现、测试资产或二进制。

100 draft family IDs，98 proposed global components（两组本仓正负 counterparts 待指定 global reviewer 复核），accepted/independently reviewed 0。作者覆盖目标 20 API /20 behavior /15 architecture /20 cross-file chains /10 config-error /15 hardnegative-noanswer；并非100已认证独立样本。100个确认组件至少仍缺2个，取决于独立去重结论。

遵循共同协议 PR65 fixed03abe24950f1fa89de3cce0a4e1d44d01e9aa0d6：按原始起草序列迁移 opaque family/variant IDs，保留旧ID、split和逐条hash；一次性固定阈值split，未重平衡或查看排名。当前公開正文仅68 native dev /57 compat dev；11个dev no-answer不进入compat。原20块迁移后12 native dev /9 compat dev，包含在100稿中，不能累计成120。32个would-be holdout全部因公开暴露/无独立受限custody而隔离，accepted holdout0，holdout_custody_blocked。历史公开正文已进入336b962和2cf6495提交；删除当前正文与作者输入不能恢复保密，污染和访问审计仍需独立custodian。此PR只报告holdout hashes/counts/status。

两组共同checker均error_count0；四个实际native/compat dev evaluator validate通过；公开dev精确源span检查通过。原字节来源为明确标注的snapshot，commit:null不冒充snapshot Git cleanliness。Primary grade3/required secondary grade2，facet/group和source-bound graph annotations有记录；现有facet/graph指标未实现，不据此声称质量通过。全程无检索/backend/provider/调参。

corpus-receipt.json、source-manifest.json、review-receipt.json、review/protocol-*与迁移hash映射可复核。完整reviewed block0；需要作者C/独立global reviewer和真正受限custodian。不是历史306raw恢复，不是live质量结论，不关闭V19。

successor69.body:

先在 d82607e 预留连续 f0101/f0102，再按固定协议计算 split；两者均 dev，无 ID 重试、重平衡或排名观察。两个新增源义务为非空 nested middleware 参数归一化与文件传输后的错误路由，与既有空参数拒绝/mount、同步 path guard/etag 状态等区别记录在作者源证据中，仍需独立审查。

新增 2 native/2 compat dev，合计 102 draft IDs、100 proposed components，公开联合投影 70 native dev/59 compat dev。旧 source/gold、suite、ID/split 迁移和两组 counterpart 合并关系逐字节不变。原 32 exposed would-be holdout 的 quarantine/custody blocker不变；新增 holdout0；独立审查/accepted0，作者未自签。

补块及联合 dev checker 均 error_count0；四个新增 actual evaluator suite validate通过；7源文件SHA/Git blob/license与新增4个精确源span验证通过。无检索/provider/调参，facet/graph指标未实现状态不变。

review/public-dev-review-entry.json 仅列公开7源文件、MIT、dev gold/suite及counts/hash材料的精确SHA256/Git blob，不包含被隔离would-be holdout正文；它是证据allowlist，不冒充访问控制。入口SHA256 b8b7fe5a22222fc91cd8e09cdccbe24e3d2fadf8e1a60df02e27a9d2ac4f6b15；补块receipt SHA25645e2faf699721c936d6f4a312f19b998bf775ecc37ba2964477e7d6e6ea66e76。

无merge/forcepush/deploy，不关闭V19，不代表历史306raw或live质量结论。
